summary: Secluded by bush and park, but a marked through road with no parking.
reasons: Through road, centre-lined, no parked cars
No verge or pull-off beside lane

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush and a grassed park; nearest home 29 m away. Very secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb meets a narrow strip and bank; no pull-off, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Collector-type road with painted lines linking to a junction; steady passing traffic likely.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the kerb and no marked parking lane.

flags: Main road with no kerbside parking
sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy shades the east side; morning sun blocked.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb allows parking at off-peak times
